notes: `מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי` writes only one *the*, and it stands before the rectum's own word, so rule 29's counting case governs rather than its fronting case and the construct noun takes no supplied determiner.
The `לְ` of `לְסִיחוֹן` is `unrepresented` under rule 40, the ASV continuing the apposition bare.
